title: Scalar-extension stalk maps preserve uniformizers at rational points
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $X$ be a smooth proper connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $P$ be a closed point of $X$. Write $X'=X\times_k k'$ and $p:X'\to X$ [def-pc-base-change]. For any $P'\in X'$ with $p(P')=P$, every irreducible element $t$ of $\mathcal O_{X,p(P')}$ has irreducible image under the stalk map $p^\#: \mathcal O_{X,p(P')}\to\mathcal O_{X',P'}$ (irreducible means nonzero, nonunit, and every factorization has a unit factor).

source.note: The blueprint invokes this as the standard valuation comparison under extension of algebraically closed fields; the available literature gives no separately named lemma.

proof.text: A closed point of X has finite residue field over k. Since k is algebraically closed, its residue field is k. Scheme.Hom.exists_fieldPoints_base_eq_iff therefore constructs a rational section through P. Scheme.Hom.baseChangeFieldPoint_eq_of_fst_eq identifies P' with its scalar extension, which is a closed immersion from Spec k'; hence P' is closed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-base-change-curve] to give the target connected curve structure and smoothness. Smoothness gives regularity by [lem-sc-smooth-regular]; connectedness gives integrality by [lem-sc-regular-connected-integral]. For either smooth integral curve, its dimension-one hypothesis gives SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1, and ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_one_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_one (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Curve.ClosedPoint) gives dimension one at the closed point. Apply [lem-sc-regular-dim1-dvr] to both closed stalks. Transport the source DVR instance along p(P')=P.

proof.text: By [lem-sc-rational-point-base-change-maximal-ideal], the source maximal ideal extends to the target maximal ideal. In a DVR irreducibility is equivalent to generating the maximal ideal (Mathlib IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer). If t is irreducible, its maximal ideal is span {t}; Ideal.map_span and Set.image_singleton identify its extension with span {p#(t)}. The target DVR criterion proves irreducibility of p#(t).

lean.statement: theorem Scheme.rational_point_base_change_stalk (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] [Algebra k k'] (X : Scheme.{u}) (s : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve s] [Smooth s] [IsProper s] (P : X) (hP : P ∈ closedPoints X) (P' : (pullback s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) : Scheme.{u})) (hP' : pullback.fst s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) P' = P) : ∀ t : X.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) P'), Irreducible t → Irreducible ((pullback.fst s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).stalkMap P' t)
